newsitem.title: USA: NIMO RESTARTS N.Y. 1,140 MW NUCLEAR UNIT.
newsitem.headline: NIMO RESTARTS N.Y. 1,140 MW NUCLEAR UNIT.

text.p: Niagara Mohawk Power Corp (NIMO) said Monday it restarted its 1,140 megawatt (MW) Nine Mile Point 2 nuclear power unit Sunday after repairing a leak in the reactor coolant system.
In a statement, NIMO said the unit was operating at 68 percent power early Monday and expected to reach full output Tuesday.
The unit, in Scriba, N.Y., was taken out of service Aug 4.
The adjoining unit 1 continued to operated at 100 percent of generating capacity.
NIMO operates both Nine Mile Point units. NIMO is the full owner of unit 1 and holds a 41 percent stake in unit 2.
Other owners of unit 2 include New York State Gas & Electric Co (18 percent), Long Island Lighting Co (18), Rochester Gas & Electric Co (14) and Central Hudson Gas & Electric Corp (9).
